title: Open Enrollment Month, Effective Dates and Surviving Spouse Continuation on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
Each sponsoring group in the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans book runs its retiree open enrollment in a stated month of the year. Two effective-date rules are scheduled with it: the rule that turns a retiree's plan option change into an effective date, and the rule that turns a disenrollment into a coverage end date. The months a surviving spouse may stay on the group plan after the retiree's death are scheduled per plan alongside them.

| Group plan | Open enrollment month | Effective date of a plan option change | Coverage end date on a disenrollment | Surviving spouse continuation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | Month 11 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 12 months |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Month 11 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 24 months |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Month 10 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 36 months |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | Month 11 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 12 months |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Month 11 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 24 months |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | Month 10 | The first day of the next plan year | The last day of the month of receipt | 36 months |

## Reading of the calendar

The open enrollment month is stated as a month of the year and not as a date within it: month 10 on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP), and month 11 on the other four plans of the book.

The two effective-date rules run on different clocks. A plan option change is carried to the start of a plan year, so two changes made in different months of the same plan year reach the same effective date; a disenrollment is carried to the end of the month it was received in, so two disenrollments received in different months reach different coverage end dates.

Surviving spouse continuation is scheduled in whole months and differs across the book, standing at 12, 24 and 36 months.
